about_the_game:
Facility 37 is a first-person cooperative horror experience for 1–5 players, where survival means documenting the horrors left behind in a decommissioned research facility, and getting out alive.

A Mission Into Madness

You are part of a covert team deployed to investigate Facility 37, a government-funded site where biological experiments went terribly wrong.
The site has been abandoned, but something still stirs in the dark.

Your goal:

  • Recover evidence

  • Document anomalies

  • Extract alive

The deeper you go, the more you’ll question why this place was buried and why it was built in the first place.

Gameplay Features

1–5 Player Online Co-op

Join forces via Steam multiplayer and built-in voice chat. Work as a team to survive, but stay alert, noise attracts danger, and being separated can be deadly.

Investigation-Focused Objectives

You’re not here to shoot your way through. Instead, you'll:

  • Collect samples and corrupted audio logs

  • Document failed experiments

  • Complete a field report before escaping

Permanent Progression

Recovered cassette logs unlock permanent entries in your archive, slowly revealing the facility’s true story. These collectibles encourage exploration and reward those who survive.

Proximity Voice Chat

Your voice is your lifeline, and your biggest risk. Enemies respond to sound. Use radios and whispers wisely.

The job is simple on paper.
Recover proof. Stay quiet. Stay alive.
But no one leaves Facility 37 the same.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains scenes and themes intended for mature audiences. These include:

- Depictions of graphic violence, blood, and dismemberment

- Scenes of body horror and disturbing experiments

- Strong horror themes including confinement, psychological distress, and death

- Implied unethical human experimentation and biohazard exposure

- Occasional written logs or environmental storytelling referencing trauma, unethical research, and death

There is no sexual content, no nudity, no depictions of sexual assault, no drug or alcohol use, and no self-harm shown explicitly.
However, the atmosphere is intense and may be distressing for players sensitive to medical horror, captivity, or fear of being hunted.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone required for voice chat
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone required for voice chat

short_description: Explore an abandoned research facility, uncover evidence of horrific experiments, and escape alive. Complete randomized objectives with your team while evading bio-engineered threats in this atmospheric co-op horror experience.
